params.name: arg
params.description: ipfs path of the object to be published.

params.name: resolve
params.description: Check if the given path can be resolved before publishing.

params.name: lifetime
params.description:
Time duration that the record will be valid for.
This accepts durations such as "300s", "1.5h" or "2h45m". Valid time units are
"ns", "us" (or "µs"), "ms", "s", "m", "h".

params.name: allow-offline
params.description: When offline, save the IPNS record to the the local datastore without broadcasting to the network instead of simply failing.

params.name: ttl
params.description: Time duration this record should be cached for. Uses the same syntax as the lifetime option. (caution: experimental).

params.name: key
params.description: Name of the key to be used or a valid PeerID, as listed by 'ipfs key list -l'.

params.name: ipns-base
params.description: Encoding used for keys: Can either be a multibase encoded CID or a base58btc encoded multihash. Takes {b58mh|base36|k|base32|b...}.

params.name: arg
params.description: The IPNS name to resolve. Defaults to your node's peerID.

params.name: recursive
params.description: Resolve until the result is not an IPNS name.

params.name: dht-record-count
params.description: Number of records to request for DHT resolution.

params.name: dht-timeout
params.description: Max time to collect values during DHT resolution eg "30s". Pass 0 for no timeout.

params.name: stream
params.description: Stream entries as they are found.

params.name: verify
params.description: CID of the public IPNS key to validate against.

params.name: arg
params.description: Name to cancel the subscription for.
